sentences.en: Fortunately, common sense prevailed and the strike was called off.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，常识占了上风，罢工被取消了。

sentences.en: Fortunately, the fire was put out before it became too serious.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，在火势变得严重之前就被扑灭了。

sentences.en: Fortunately, my son quickly adjusted to life in his new school.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，我儿子很快就适应了新学校的生活。

senses.zh: 幸好, 幸运地, 还好
